notice: FICTIONAL: every snippet was written for this corpus in common job-posting wording. No company, posting or person is real.
labels: Each row lists the hard requirements a careful reader finds in the snippet: work_authorization, sponsorship:refused, sponsorship:offered, citizenship_or_clearance, location, language or degree. A preference (preferred, a plus, ideally) or a degree with an 'or equivalent experience' alternative is not a hard requirement. Years of experience are out of scope (jd-years.mjs, engine suite).
